audit.whatIsWrong: diff TRICKY / 7.5-10 and the level chart (Mel L1, Skill L2, Yasuo L3-5, Mel L6, Yasuo after) disagree with the mirror audit, which moved mel__yasuo to EVEN 6/10 and flagged that all seven phase sides need a human decision.
audit.why: Yasuo's Emerald+ win rate here is 55.89% over 950 games, which does not support Mel winning six of seven stages as the mirror suggested; the mirror agent deliberately did not propose the flips. Chart edits are atomic and must not be half-proposed, so I left both layers untouched and raised it as a question.
audit.corrected: No chart edit proposed. Question recorded for the user naming the exact rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Rebuttal 'reflects your abilities' with no cooldown and implied R is the answer; spikes[3] and content.late claimed Wind Wall counters Rebuttal.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W) is a 250-range self-barrier on 38/35/33/29/26s that prevents damage and reflects projectiles back — Wind Wall cannot interact with it at all. The real spike sequencing is: bait the barrier, then EQ-knockup into Last Breath (70/50/30s).
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text with the rank-5 26s number and the bait-then-commit sequence; rewrote spikes[3].text and content.late to name what Wind Wall actually blocks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The file told the player Wind Wall answers Rebuttal and Solar Snare, and never mentioned Golden Eclipse's range-independent execute.
audit.why: The projectile flags are on Radiant Volley (Q), Solar Snare (E) and her passive's bonus attack projectiles — those are what Wind Wall deletes. Golden Eclipse carries no projectile flag and 'strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her', so no wall, no range and no dash escapes it, and it scales with stacks toward the passive's execute. Steel Tempest's whirlwind is a projectile, so casting Q into an active Rebuttal reflects it back at you — that is the real reason to hold Q.
audit.corrected: Restated Wind Wall's true targets in report[5].t, dosFull[2].d, spikes[3].text and content.late; put Golden Eclipse's wall-and-range-ignoring Overwhelm execute into whys[6] and breakdown.late; put the Rebuttal reflect-on-Steel-Tempest reason into spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed only Solar Snare and two vague self-references.
audit.why: Rebuttal at 38s rank 1 down to 26s rank 5 is the single most punishable window in this lane, and Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Naming both makes the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Added Rebuttal's 26s rank-5 cooldown and Solar Snare's ~9s to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Mel's Overwhelm execute threshold or the passive's bonus-projectile attack tell.
audit.why: Overwhelm stacks infinitely and executes at a threshold, so the player must track an HP number rather than a health bar; every ability cast loads her next attack with up to nine bonus projectiles, which is the visible wind-up cue.
audit.corrected: Execute warning added to breakdown.late ('never sit low'). The bonus-projectile tell is recorded here but not written to any field, as no field could carry it inside the length band without dropping verified content.
